title: r1 minor DR: display-field identifiers drift between statusline-data and snapshot-schema
description: Evidence: statusline-data.md:37-42 (repo-name, work-item, milestone-with-count; five fields) vs snapshot-schema.md:28-32 (display_repo_name, display_work_item, display_active_milestone; four) — same fields, different names, and the count gap (phase-answer is derived, not materialized) is implicit. Disposition: align identifiers or add the one-line correspondence note. Data-side. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, statusline-data 0.2.0): the correspondence-note path — statusline prose now maps each glance field to its snapshot field, states phase-answer as derived-never-materialized, and places display_session with the human form after the #679 demotion. Identifiers unchanged on both sides (renames would ripple through two adopted sets for cosmetic gain). Round 2 re-verifies (validator: solution-architect).
